Print the script that completes wdx commands in a shell.

The script asks wdx for the candidates on every Tab, so it completes new commands and flags as soon as wdx is updated. Project and terminal names and ids come from the daemon; nothing is offered when it is not running.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`wdx completion bash`](#wdx-completion-bash) | Print the bash completion script |
| [`wdx completion fish`](#wdx-completion-fish) | Print the fish completion script |
| [`wdx completion zsh`](#wdx-completion-zsh) | Print the zsh completion script |

## wdx completion bash

Print the bash completion script.

```sh
wdx completion bash [flags]
```

Load it in this shell with source &lt;(wdx completion bash), or for every shell save it as ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/wdx; the bash-completion package must be installed. The installer does the latter.

### Examples

```sh
# Print the script
wdx completion bash
```

### Output

The script, and nothing else. With `--json`: {"shell": "bash", "script": "..."}

### Errors

| Code | Exit | When |
|---|---|---|
| [`usage`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#usage) | 2 | the request, command line or a setting is invalid |
| [`internal`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#internal) | 3 | an unexpected failure: database, filesystem or git |

## wdx completion fish

Print the fish completion script.

```sh
wdx completion fish [flags]
```

Save it as ~/.config/fish/completions/wdx.fish. The installer does it.

### Examples

```sh
# Print the script
wdx completion fish
```

### Output

The script, and nothing else. With `--json`: {"shell": "fish", "script": "..."}

### Errors

| Code | Exit | When |
|---|---|---|
| [`usage`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#usage) | 2 | the request, command line or a setting is invalid |
| [`internal`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#internal) | 3 | an unexpected failure: database, filesystem or git |

## wdx completion zsh

Print the zsh completion script.

```sh
wdx completion zsh [flags]
```

Save it as \_wdx in a directory of your fpath, such as ~/.zsh/completions with fpath=(~/.zsh/completions $fpath) before compinit in ~/.zshrc. The installer does it.

### Examples

```sh
# Print the script
wdx completion zsh
```

### Output

The script, and nothing else. With `--json`: {"shell": "zsh", "script": "..."}

### Errors

| Code | Exit | When |
|---|---|---|
| [`usage`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#usage) | 2 | the request, command line or a setting is invalid |
| [`internal`](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/#internal) | 3 | an unexpected failure: database, filesystem or git |
